tasks.label: Profile: Collect Trace (Until Close)
args: Write-Host 'Waiting for Memux to start...'; Start-Sleep 5; $found = $false; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { $processes = Get-Process dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object StartTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 3; foreach ($p in $processes) { try { $cmdLine = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $($p.Id)").CommandLine; if ($cmdLine -like '*Memux.App*') { Write-Host "Found Memux process PID: $($p.Id)"; Write-Host 'Collecting trace until you close Memux...'; dotnet-trace collect --process-id $($p.Id) --profile cpu-sampling --output memux-trace.nettrace; Write-Host 'Trace collected: memux-trace.nettrace'; $found = $true; break; } } catch {} } if ($found) { break; } Start-Sleep 1; } if (-not $found) { Write-Host 'Memux process not found after 30 seconds. Please check if Memux started correctly.' }

tasks.label: Profile: Quick 60s Trace
args: Write-Host 'Starting Memux in background...'; Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','--project','src/Memux.App/Memux.App.csproj' -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep 5; $PID = (Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.ProcessName -like '*Memux*' -or $_.ProcessName -like '*dotnet*'} | Select-Object -First 1).Id; if ($PID) { Write-Host "Collecting 60s trace from PID: $PID"; dotnet-trace collect --process-id $PID --duration 00:01:00 --profile cpu-sampling --output memux-trace.nettrace; dotnet-trace convert memux-trace.nettrace --format speedscope; Write-Host '✓ Done! Upload memux-trace.speedscope.json to https://www.speedscope.app/' } else { Write-Host 'No Memux process found' }

tasks.label: Profile: Start and Attach to Memux
args: &{Write-Host 'Starting Memux...'; $job = Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Set-Location $using:PWD; dotnet run --project src/Memux.App/Memux.App.csproj }; Start-Sleep 5; Write-Host 'Looking for Memux process...'; $found = $false; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { $processes = Get-Process dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object StartTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 5; foreach ($p in $processes) { try { $cmdLine = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $($p.Id)").CommandLine; if ($cmdLine -like '*Memux.App*') { Write-Host "Found Memux PID: $($p.Id)"; Write-Host 'Collecting trace. Close Memux when done...'; dotnet-trace collect --process-id $($p.Id) --profile cpu-sampling --output memux-trace.nettrace; Write-Host 'Converting to speedscope format...'; dotnet-trace convert memux-trace.nettrace --format speedscope --output memux-trace.speedscope.json; Write-Host '✓ Trace saved and converted!'; Start-Process 'https://www.speedscope.app/'; $found = $true; break; } } catch {} } if ($found) { break; } Start-Sleep 1; } if (-not $found) { Write-Host 'Memux not found after 30 seconds.'; Remove-Job $job -Force }}
